table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	ProdCode,
	ProdRowID,
	RowID,
	Posted=(SELECT DISTINCT H.Posted FROM ProdDetail D, ProdHeader H WHERE ProdBuffer.ProdRowID = D.RowID AND H.ProdCode=D.ProdCode), 
	ProdDate=(SELECT DISTINCT H.Date FROM ProdDetail D, ProdHeader H WHERE ProdBuffer.ProdRowID = D.RowID AND H.ProdCode=D.ProdCode), 
	UserName=(SELECT DISTINCT U.UserName FROM ProdDetail D, ProdHeader H, Users U WHERE ProdBuffer.ProdRowID = D.RowID AND H.ProdCode=D.ProdCode AND H.FinalizedBy=U.UserCode), 
	ProducedItemCode=(SELECT D.ICode FROM ProdDetail D WHERE ProdBuffer.ProdRowID = D.RowID),   
	ProducedItemAliasName = (SELECT I.CustomICode FROM ProdDetail D, Item I WHERE ProdBuffer.ProdRowID = D.RowID AND D.ICode=I.ICode),   
	ProducedItemName =(SELECT I.Name FROM ProdDetail D, Item I WHERE ProdBuffer.ProdRowID = D.RowID AND D.ICode=I.ICode),   
	ProducedItemQty =(SELECT D.Qty FROM ProdDetail D WHERE ProdBuffer.ProdRowID = D.RowID),   
	ProducedItemBatch =(SELECT D.Batch FROM ProdDetail D WHERE ProdBuffer.ProdRowID = D.RowID),   
	ProducedItemExpiry =(SELECT D.Expiry FROM ProdDetail D WHERE ProdBuffer.ProdRowID = D.RowID),   
	ItemClass = (SELECT IC.Name FROM ItemClass IC WHERE IC.ICCode = Item.ICCode),
	ItemPacking = (SELECT IP.Name FROM ItemPacking IP WHERE IP.PackCode = Item.PackCode),
	CRNO=(SELECT DISTINCT H.Remarks FROM ProdDetail D, ProdHeader H WHERE ProdBuffer.ProdRowID = D.RowID AND H.ProdCode=D.ProdCode), 
	ICode=Item.ICode,   
	FullCode= Item.CustomICode,
	ItemName = Item.Name,
	Remarks=ProdBuffer.Remarks,   
	PackPrice=ProdBuffer.PackPrice,
	Price=ProdBuffer.Price,
	PackUnits=ProdBuffer.PackUnits,
	ItemFlatDisc=ProdBuffer.ItemFlatDisc,
	DiscPerc=ProdBuffer.DiscPerc,
	ProcessCharge=ProdBuffer.ProcessCharge,
	ProcessChargePerc=ProdBuffer.ProcessChargePerc,
	Qty=ProdBuffer.Qty,
	WeightInGrams = ISNULL(ProdBuffer.Qty,0) * ISNULL((SELECT IP.NumericalFactor FROM ItemPacking IP WHERE IP.PackCode = Item.PackCode),0),
	RecipeQty=(SELECT RD.Qty
	FROM Recipe R, RecipeDetail RD
	WHERE R.ResultedItem IN (SELECT D.ICode FROM ProdDetail D WHERE ProdBuffer.ProdRowID = D.RowID) AND
		R.Priority IN (SELECT MIN(RR.Priority) FROM Recipe RR WHERE RR.ResultedItem = R.ResultedItem) AND
		R.RecipeCode = RD.RecipeCode AND 
		RD.ICode = ProdBuffer.ICode)
FROM 
	ProdBuffer, Item
WHERE 
	ProdBuffer.ProdCode = :ai_prodcode AND
	ProdBuffer.ICode = Item.ICode
table.sort: prodrowid A, itempacking A, itemname A
